newsitem.title: UK: London shares end lower as Wall Street woes weigh.
newsitem.headline: London shares end lower as Wall Street woes weigh.

text.p: UK shares gave back all of Thursday's gains as investors worried that Wall Street could be on the verge of a major correction.
A profits warning from one of Britain's leading supermarket chains also undermined market confidence but strategists believe the FTSE is only pausing for breath before testing new highs.
"Fundamentally, we are still bullish of the UK market," said Corey Miller, equities strategist at Credit Lyonnais Laing.
"Markets on both sides of the Atlantic have performed strongly so it's to be expected that we now have a bit of profit-taking." The FTSE 100 ended 52.7 points down at 4,218.8.
